function buildStarPostPipeline(s, deps): void;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/post.ts:53

Assembles the RenderPipeline post chain (screen-space, in order): scene → +bloom → vignette → film grain Bloom sits first so the vignette shapes the halos too, and grain lands last so it dithers the final frame. On any failure the pipeline is torn down and s.pipeline stays null — the frame loop then renders the scene directly with no post.
